SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Emergency department discharge instructions
Visit reason: cough for 5 days. Seen and discharged home by the treating physician.

Medications:
Use Albuterol inhaler 2 puffs by inhalation every 4 hours as needed for wheezing for 7 days.
Take Benzonatate 100 mg by mouth three times a day as needed for cough for 5 days.
Take Ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth every 8 hours with food as needed for 3 days.

Follow-up and return precautions

See your primary care clinician within 3 days if the cough is not improving.
Return to the emergency department for chest pain, trouble breathing, coughing up blood, or fever above 39 C.
Rest and avoid smoke exposure.
Drink plenty of fluids.
